As required by federal regulation, a relocation program was submitted. This plan has been reviewed and approved by the Federal Highway Administration and the Wisconsin Department of Local Affairs and Development. The original submittal was approved September 5, 1969 and was updated on August 23, 1971 and again on March 24, 1972 to reflect revisions in available housing. The present inventory indicates that there will be no change in the relocation plans as approved. On March 19, 1975 the available housing was again updated. This inventory showed in the last six months there were 212 one-bedroom, 327 two-hedroom, and 60 three-bedroom rental units available; and 6 two-bedroom, 56 three-bedroom, and 11 four-bedroom purchase properties available. Currently there are 61 rental units and 55 purchase properties available. The area surveyed was bounded by Oklahoma Avenue on the north, Ryan Road on the south, Lake Michigan on the east and South 27th Street on the West. The approved Pelocation Program Plans and the updated housing data are included in Appendix A. Pemaining relocations are shown in Figure 17. Competition for available housing for displacees of Airport Spur project should not be a factor.
All local through streets crossing the route of the proposed freeway will be grade separated to minimize interruption of present traffic patterns and thereby not adversely affect the neighborhood.
